title: The House of Horrors
description: Vigilant Tyranus seeks help investigating an abandoned house in Markarth rumored to harbor Daedric activity. Inside, the Daedric Prince Molag Bal forces a lethal confrontation and demands the player bring a priest of Boethiah to his desecrated altar for submission.

base_facts: A Vigilant of Stendarr investigating the abandoned house in Markarth for Daedric activity.
Believes the house is a site of Daedric worship and seeks help to investigate.

QUEST_BEGUN: I agreed to help Tyranus investigate the abandoned house.
TYRANUS_DEAD: Tyranus was driven mad by the Daedric presence in the house and attacked me. I had no choice but to kill him.

base_facts: Daedric Prince of Domination who seeks to harvest mortal souls for Coldharbour.
His altar in the Markarth abandoned house was desecrated by a priest of Boethiah.

MOLAG_BAL_SPEAKS: Molag Bal trapped me at his altar and demanded I bring the priest of Boethiah to him.
He wants the priest to bend the knee and pledge his soul, not mere revenge.
QUEST_COMPLETE: Molag Bal transformed the rusty mace into the Mace of Molag Bal and granted its true power as reward for breaking and killing Logrolf at his altar.
Logrolf submitted, pledged his soul, and forsook Boethiah before being slain; Molag Bal claimed his soul for Coldharbour.
Molag Bal declared he will be watching when enemies lie broken and bloody, then departed to claim Logrolf's soul in Oblivion.
Molag Bal's rivalry with Boethiah over the desecrated altar is settled; the altar has been re-consecrated through the submission and death of Boethiah's own priest.

base_facts: An elderly priest of Boethiah captured by Forsworn in the Reach.
Known as the Willful for his stubborn devotion to Boethiah.

LOGROLF_FREED: I freed Logrolf from the Forsworn. He was suspicious but headed back toward Markarth.
LOGROLF_DEFEATED: I beat Logrolf into submission before Molag Bal's altar and killed him at the Daedric Prince's command.

beats.comment: Player agrees to help Tyranus investigate the abandoned house in Markarth.
Supernatural events in the house drive Tyranus mad; the player must kill him.
Molag Bal traps the player and demands the priest of Boethiah be brought to his altar.
Player finds and frees Logrolf the Willful from Forsworn captivity in the Reach.
Logrolf is beaten into submission and killed at Molag Bal's altar.
Molag Bal rewards the player with the Mace of Molag Bal after Logrolf's soul is claimed.
